llm.guidance: This skill is instruction-only and coherent with its stated purpose, but there is no implementation included for review. Before using it: (1) confirm where the analysis actually runs (on your machine, in the OpenClaw platform, or a third-party service); (2) avoid uploading sensitive or PII-containing datasets until you know the execution environment and data handling policy; (3) ask the publisher for the implementation/source code or a trustworthy homepage if you need stronger assurance; (4) note the version mismatch between registry metadata (1.0.30) and skill.json (1.0.0) and consider asking the author to clarify.
